_comment: Printec BANKING solution taxonomy — the full set of banking-relevant Printec offerings from the Jan-2026 Company Presentation (knowledge-base/_reference/printec-company-presentation.md), excluding pure-retail lines (self-checkout, vending, pharmacy robots, EV-charging, parcel lockers, ESL, robot sorting). Each category maps a demand signal to a sellable Printec offering AND is the search checklist the research agents use (they must hunt demand signals for EVERY category, not just ATM/POS). 'keywords' are matched case-insensitive, word-boundary aware, against bank_theme + signal + implies + follow_up to auto-classify a signal; a signal may map to several categories. A trailing '*' marks a STEM that also matches inflections (e.g. 'recycl*' -> recycling/recycler/recyclers). Plain tokens require full word boundaries (so 'pos' matches POS but not 'deposit'; 'cit' matches CIT but not 'citizens'). Refresh this file each cycle from the latest Printec products deck (Orchestrator duty).

categories.label: ATM & cash automation / recycling
categories.printec: NCR ATMs (dispense / intelligent-deposit / recycling), cash recyclers, teller cash recyclers & smart safes (Sesami/Glory/Consillion), APTRA OptiCash cash management

categories.label: Self-service, kiosks & branch transformation
categories.printec: Self-service kiosks, bank kiosk (assisted), APS/SmartPay payment terminals, x-core true-self-service software, x-visio digital signage & QMS, branch transformation / phygital fit-out

categories.label: POS, acquiring & terminal management
categories.printec: EFT-POS terminals & PinPads (Verifone/Castles), softPOS, x-pos Android platform, Terminal Management System (TMS), POSight monitoring, payment facilitation / switching (Watch4Pay)

categories.label: Payments modernization (instant / ISO 20022)
categories.printec: Instant-payments infrastructure, ISO 20022 alignment, payment-hub integration, Verification of Payee, digital-euro readiness

categories.label: Digital identity, onboarding & e-signature
categories.printec: Digital identity / eKYC onboarding (video ID, biometrics, liveness), eIDAS e-signature & qualified trust services (Namirial), EUDI-wallet acceptance

categories.label: Fraud & transaction monitoring
categories.printec: Real-time transaction monitoring & fraud prevention (INETCO Insight, FICO), payment-fraud analytics

categories.label: Compliance & operational resilience
categories.printec: AML/compliance suite (Siron), DORA/operational-resilience tooling, accessibility (EAA) compliance, reconciliation & data integrity (FIS), chargeback/dispute, document management

categories.label: Physical ATM security
categories.printec: ATM physical security: IBNS banknote neutralisation (Eve/Even), Oberthur ICSD/PADS, vault locks, surge protection (Raycap); CIT-adjacent

categories.label: Payment security & key management (HSM)
categories.printec: Payment HSMs (Thales payShield 10K), remote key injection (ERKM/SLKI), PCI-PIN secure key services / Payments Room, card-crypto for issuing & acquiring

categories.label: Card issuing & management
categories.printec: Card issuing / management / personalisation support, issuer-processor crypto & card-platform integration (HSM, tokenisation, scheme migration)

categories.label: Managed services / outsourcing
categories.printec: Managed/customer services, ATM-as-a-Service, device telemetry & remote monitoring, field/maintenance services (500+ engineers), cash-management services, BPO

categories.label: Core / digital channels (adjacent)
categories.printec: Integration & self-service adjacency around core-banking and digital-channel programmes (FIS core; often precedes channel spend)
